meta_description:
14K likes, 1,590 comments - esquireindia on July 30, 2026: "For years, Arjun Kapoor (@arjunkapoor) measured life by what came next: the next film, the next opportunity, the next version of himself. But somewhere along the way, the chase stopped defining him. Turning forty, embracing therapy, travelling without an agenda and learning to enjoy his own company have all reshaped the way he sees success. 

In our latest digital cover story, Arjun Kapoor reflects on grief, growth, family and why the greatest achievement isn’t getting somewhere else, but finally feeling at home with who you already are. 

Chairperson: Avarna Jain (@avarna_jain) 
CEO: Debashish Ghosh 

Editor and Words by: Rahul Gangwani (@rahulgangs_) 

Photographer: Antonio Giancaspro (@agf_281)
Styling: Komal Shetty (@komal_shetty_) 
HMU: Sara Bergaglio (@sara.bergaglio)
Location: Hilton Molino Stucky Venice (@hiltonvenice)

On Arjun: 

Midnight blue pinstripe wool double-breasted blazer and pants, short-sleeved merino wool polo shirt in navy-blue and Ball Star in white leather with dark blue leather star and silver laminated leather heel tab, all by Golden Goose (@goldengoose)

An @rpsg.lifestylemedia publication by @rpsggroup.

#EsquireIndia #ArjunKapoor".
